clue.text: Coffee diluted originally'- one rejected very loudly

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the word diluted
rejected means the word for one is sent back, so it is read backwards

parts.note: an ace is the one in a pack of cards
FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Someone sends back a watered-down coffee with a loud complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' is a card-player's ace; 'rejected' sends it backwards in the middle of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A decaff is a cup of decaffeinated coffee, the informal short name for it.

clue.text: Classic film press avoids at first

indicators.note: at first places the word for avoids before the word for press

parts.note: to duck something is to avoid it
OUP is Oxford University Press

explanation.surface: A classic film that the press dodges at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Duck Soup is the 1933 Marx Brothers comedy, regarded as a classic film.

clue.text: Penniless fellow given drink

indicators.note: penniless means without P, the abbreviation for a penny

parts.note: a chap is a fellow

explanation.surface: A broke man is handed a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Cha is an informal British word for tea, a drink.

clue.text: Counterfeit gold is imported from abroad

indicators.note: is imported means brought into the inside of the word for counterfeit

parts.note: to feign is to counterfeit or fake
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Fake gold has been brought in from overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Foreign describes something coming from another country, from abroad.

clue.text: Modest record by engineers assigned to Eiffel Tower, initial

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's engineering corps

indicators.note: initial asks for the opening letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: A self-effacing account of engineers working on the Eiffel Tower.
explanation.definitionFit: Discreet behaviour is restrained and unshowy, so modest is a fair synonym.

clue.text: It's a bind for the electrician

definitions.text: It's a bind for the electrician

parts.words: It's a bind for the electrician
parts.note: a bind sounds like a nuisance, but here it is something that literally binds wires for an electrician

explanation.definitionFit: Electricians wrap this protective adhesive strip round wires to bind and insulate them.

clue.text: Coin' small boy found in church? Not so

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the word that follows

parts.note: no means not so
Tim, as in Tiny Tim, is a small boy

explanation.surface: A coin and a small boy turn up in church, or perhaps not.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a boy in church, but 'found in' puts him inside the word for 'Not so'; the question mark teases that church is no container here.
explanation.definitionFit: A centimo is a small coin, a hundredth part of currencies such as the old peseta.

clue.text: .Excessive additional tax involving most of workers

parts.note: extra means additional

indicators.note: involving means wrapping round the shortened word that follows

parts.note: VAT is value added tax

indicators.note: most of means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a gang is a group of workers

explanation.surface: An extra tax that hits workers is too much.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' shortens the word for workers by its final letter before 'involving' wraps the tax round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Extravagant means going beyond what is reasonable, the same as excessive.

clue.text: Executioner's hat

definitions.meaning: slang for someone who kills, as in topping a condemned prisoner

explanation.definitionFit: Topper is slang for an executioner, from top meaning kill, and also a top hat.

clue.text: Train for meteorology here?

parts.note: suggests a stop for trains serving weather study, but means a site where conditions are recorded

explanation.definitionFit: A weather station is a facility where meteorological readings are taken.

clue.text: Carer on ship is trained for leading man on board?

indicators.note: being trained suggests the letters are drilled into a new order

explanation.surface: A carer working aboard a ship gets training to lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading man on board' is not a ship's officer but the person heading a board of directors; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: The person leading a company board's meetings is its chair, so this is a playful periphrasis.

clue.text: Advice given gratuitously

definitions.meaning: a useful hint or pointer passed on
a gratuity left for a waiter, money handed over beyond the bill

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a helpful hint and a gratuity, matching each half of the clue.

clue.text: Loan is needed in a way to keep going

parts.note: a sub is an advance or loan of money

indicators.note: in places the word is inside the abbreviation for a way

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
taken as written

explanation.surface: Borrowing money is the only way to stay afloat.
explanation.definitionFit: To subsist is to stay alive or carry on, especially on limited means.

clue.text: Group drowned by accompaniment for Travelling Light?

indicators.note: drowned by means swallowed up inside the word that follows

parts.note: backing is a musical accompaniment
a pack is a group

explanation.surface: A band is drowned out by its backing music.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiking with only a rucksack is a way of travelling light, carrying everything on your back.

clue.text: East of Los Angeles I get heated accommodation for animals

indicators.note: in an across answer east is to the right, so what follows comes after the city

parts.note: taken as written
to rage is to get heated with anger

explanation.surface: Somewhere east of LA, a speaker grows angry about a shelter for animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Lairage is a place where livestock are rested, often on the way to market or slaughter.

clue.text: Nonconformist nuns involved in wedding by a lake (14) flight?

indicators.note: being involved in something means being wrapped up within it

parts.note: a wedding is a union of two people
a convent is a community of nuns
L is a common abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: Unorthodox nuns take part in a lakeside wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Unconventional means departing from the norm, the same idea as nonconformist.

clue.text: Tureens set out? I'll tuck in, being very hungry

indicators.note: tuck in means put inside the rearranged letters
set out suggests the letters are laid out afresh

parts.note: the I of I'll, with the will as surface

explanation.surface: With soup tureens laid out, a famished diner digs in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set out' gives ESURENT from TUREENS, and 'tuck in' places I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Esurient is a literary word for greedy or hungry.

clue.text: Selection of fruit served in flight?

definitions.meaning: a mixed offering of two common orchard fruits
the rhyming-slang phrase means stairs, and stairs serve in a flight

explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang, a London dialect, the phrase means stairs; a flight is a set of stairs, not air travel.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally two fruits; as Cockney rhyming slang the phrase stands for stairs, which make up a flight.

clue.text: Council fails to start working on time, producing design …

indicators.note: working signals the letters are put to work in a new order
fails to start means the first letter is lost

explanation.surface: A council's slow start on a project still yields a design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fails to start' gives OUNCIL, which 'working' rearranges to LINOCU, then T is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A linocut is a print or design cut into linoleum.

clue.text: … without embellishment, obviously

explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means both simply, undecorated, and clearly or evidently.

clue.text: One represented by lawyer has right to appear in court

indicators.note: to appear in means set inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: a lien is a legal right over property

explanation.surface: A lawyer's customer has the right to show up in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A client is a person on whose behalf a lawyer acts.

clue.text: Girl with endless fortune in deposit account

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off the word for fortune

parts.note: luck is fortune
taken as written
DA is the abbreviation for a deposit account

explanation.surface: A girl whose windfall sits in her savings account.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucinda is a girl's first name.

clue.text: Followed a noisy farm vehicle

indicators.note: noisy indicates the words are to be spoken and heard

parts.note: tracked means followed, plus the article a

explanation.surface: A loud farm machine came along behind.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken in a British accent, with no final R, 'tracked a' sounds like the vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tractor is the classic powered vehicle used for farm work.

clue.text: Priest restricted by the liturgy

indicators.note: restricted by means held within the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A clergyman is hemmed in by the forms of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: Eli is the priest of Shiloh in the Old Testament who raised Samuel.

clue.text: Type of furniture stripper

definitions.meaning: an 18th-century English style of furniture named after its maker
a member of a famous troupe of male strippers

explanation.definitionFit: The name is both a classic furniture style and a member of the well-known male strip troupe.

clue.text: Suffer cold shower, not hot.

indicators.note: not removes the letter for hot from the word before

parts.note: hail is a cold shower of ice
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: Endure a cold shower with no hot water.
explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to be unwell, to suffer.

clue.text: American footballer near goal

parts.note: tight can mean close or near, as in a tight finish
an end is a goal or aim

explanation.surface: A gridiron player is closing in on the goal line.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight end is a playing position in American football, lining up at the end of the line.

clue.text: Told to purchase piece of land — that's not the whole story

indicators.note: told means the words are spoken aloud and heard

parts.note: buy is purchase and plot is a piece of land

explanation.surface: Someone is advised to buy land, but there's more to the tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A by-plot is a subsidiary storyline, a side part rather than the main narrative.
